sqls.sql: select ts, _value, diff(ts) as duration,(case when _value like "%Stopping%" then "Unavailable" when _value like "%Starting%" then "Available" when _value like "%Standby%" then "Unavailable" "%RunUF%" then "Available" "%RunPQ%" then "Available" "%Ready%" then "Available" "%Fault%" then "Unavailable" "%Off%" then "Unavailable" "%No%" then "Unavailable" "%Connecting%" then "Available" "%Disconnecting%" then "Available" "%GoingToStandby%" then "Available" else "No Data" end) as status, unit_controller_id, from (select ts, concat(last_row(`InvStatus`), "-", last_row(`RunMode`)) as _value, unit_controller_id from ems.site where ts between TIME_TRUNCATE(now, 1h) and TIME_TRUNCATE(now, 1h) + 1h and site_controller_id != "undefined" order by ts asc partition by unit_controller_id interval(1m) fill(PREV));

select (case 1.0 * `UnitsOnline` / 20.0 when chast_flt = 1.0 and locremctl_flt = 1.0 then 1.0 else 0.0 end) as mean, "system_availability" as point_name from ems.site where ts between (TIMETRUNCATE(NOW(), 1h) - 1h) and TIMETRUNCATE(NOW(), 1h)partition by site_controller_id;

select (case 1.0 * `abc` / 20.0 when ighg = 1.0 and iigg = 1.0 then 1.0 else 0.0 end) as mean, "system_availability" as point_name from ems.site where ts between (TIMETRUNCATE('2025-10-01 07:29:16.340+08:00', 1h) - 1h)and TIMETRUNCATE('2025-10-01 07:29:16.340+08:00', 1h) partition by site_controller_id;
